name: 85351 · Sun City, AZ
findings: ZIP 85351 (Sun City) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 32 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 85351 (Sun City) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
